correctness.rationale: For target j, doxasticity confines incoming vertices to {0,...,j}; AP compatibility makes the column downward closed, hence uniquely empty or {0,...,c_j}, giving j+2 independent choices and total (n+1)!. A nonempty edge vRt witnesses basicity at every s via u=max(s,v), so founded frames are exactly the nonempty ones. Under AP, visionaryness is seriality; doxasticity at the top forces the top loop, which fills the top incoming column. Hence epistemic frames are exactly c_{n-1}=n-1, giving n! and fraction 1/(n+1). Independent small-n enumeration agrees; the proof is the all-n column bijection.

value.rationale: Finite chains are canonical linearly ordered intuitionistic frames. The theorem gives a complete normal form and simultaneous exact counts for natural doxastic, founded and epistemic subclasses, with a transparent top-column characterization of epistemicity. This is a natural complete finite classification.
